title: Sign in
subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to continue to {product}.
remember: Keep me signed in on this device
tagline: IS help, requests and approvals in one place.
taglineDetail: Ask IS for help, request access or equipment, and see who it is waiting for.

features.requests: Request access and equipment, and see who approves

errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: This account is not active. Contact your administrator.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_PROVISIONED: Your account has not been set up in this platform yet.
errors.SSO_STATE: The sign-in session expired. Please try again.
errors.SSO_DENIED: Sign-in was cancelled at your identity provider.
errors.SSO_FAILED: Single sign-on failed. Please try again or contact IS.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

cantSignInBody: Check that your username and password are typed correctly. If it still fails, contact the IS service desk. They can reset your password and check your account.
